name: Rayen Lycon
source:
The Zeta Wolf

An antisocial teen who has yearned for the touch of a girlfriend for many years. Swears that he will stop at nothing to get a girl before senior prom. Due to his naive nature and lack of friends he resorts to unorthodox tactics to pick up girls, with many attempts failing due to his lack of confidence.

Hobbies: Video games (MMOs), idling in the bathroom?
